items.textToSpeech: For children under 18, the Population Reference Intakes for zinc increase with age and range from 2.9 milligrams per day for those aged 7-11 months, up to 14.2 milligrams of zinc per day for males aged 15-17, and up to 11.9 milligrams of zinc per day for females aged 15-17. See the associated table or the source document for full details.
The Population Reference Intake is the level of nutrient intake that will meet the requirements of 97.5% of the individuals in the population. Is there anything else I can help you with?
